title: PRESSER | Trinidad Chambliss - Postgame vs Oklahoma (11-16-26)
text: Turn out I know there's there's still games left, but this one probably knocked you guys out of the playoff picture. I guess just how would you evaluate what this season has been like? >> Well, it's not done yet like you said. Um yes, it probably knocked us out of college football playoffs, but you know I still got two more, you know, regular season games with my guys and the coaches that brought me here and um you know have just poured so much in this program and this team and uh I'm truly just grateful and uh just blessed. Honestly just blessed. >> You guys took a while to kind of get going offensively and start to get anything consistent. How frustrating was that today and what attributed to that? >> Yeah, I mean um yeah, just you know rough start for us offensively. Um you know opening drive, you know you know can't get the ball movement. Um you know the rain you know played a factor uh but I played in you know worser conditions in my career so uh that's not an excuse at all. Um but yeah, we just got to be better, you know, and have a faster start offensively. Um I feel like that's a you know big key in you know winning games and not winning games. >> To be at this point and how we have a couple games out and still be struggling with those opening drives struggling. What do you kind of attribute that to? Why why is it just not clicked on opening drives? What's been the struggle there? >> [sighs] >> Honestly um just not executing. Um we got to execute better. Um you know me as a quarterback I got to put our guys in a better position. Um and um yeah, I mean we just got to execute so um and finding ways to get first downs cuz I mean it's not going to be easy out there. We know that. Um and you know they have really good defense and uh yeah, I mean we got to we got to figure something out and um have a faster start to games. >> It seems like it's been really hard for y'all all year. It's always hard out there. Why do you think it's kind of Is it felt that way to y'all and and and what's kind of led to that just joining this in in mind? >> I feel like, you know, teams are um you know just doing a good job with scouting us and you know seeing what we like to do um based off, you know, tendencies out of formations and stuff and um you know they coach really well. You know it's hard to win games in the SEC regardless of their schedule, regardless who they played and um and yeah, I mean, you know, we faced good defenses week in and week out. And yeah, I mean, we got we got to figure some stuff out, go back to the drawing board and yeah, try to figure out, you know, how we can, you know, start games faster. >> What have the past couple days been like with all the the travel stuff and everything around this week? >> It's been It's been weird for sure, but I mean, our guys never blinked. You know, we we stayed locked in, we stayed focused. We had a lot of walkthroughs, a lot of meetings, and just staying mentally prepared for the game cuz at the end of the day, we were going to play a game, whether it was going to be today or yesterday or even next week or whatever. So, you know, I'm proud of my guys for staying locked in. And yeah, it was a little weird, but I mean, it didn't really affect us. >> Obviously, when you came back, you didn't envision this being where y'all were, you know, two games left. For you, what what do the next two games represent and what do you kind of want to show and do for the guys? Like how do you kind of keep everything, you know, motivated? >> Yeah, I mean, just going back to my why. I sent a text out to the guys yesterday and just saying, you know, love them. Whatever it is you play for, if you play for the, you know, last name on your back or you know, other reasons and whatever it is, you know, just, you know, compete your ass off. Play like this is the last game you'll ever play cuz nothing is guaranteed in life and we're honestly blessed to be given opportunities like this. And you know, that's my approach going to be for the next, you know, two games is you know, there's other kids out there that would love to be in my position. They would love to be the quarterback at Ole Miss. So, just going in, attacking it, and enjoying football and having fun with my guys. And yeah, you know, in the season, this is not where we want to be, but you know, it is what it is. You know, now we just got to put our best tape on on Saturday versus Wofford and yeah, go from there. So, just having an open mindset and just, you know, going to enjoy it the rest of the year. >> Questions? Thanks, Ray. >> Appreciate you guys.
